editorial_review_row.content: Tickmill is a legitimate FCA-regulated ECN broker scoring 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. The 2025-2026 expansion added TradingView, a proprietary platform (Tickmill Trader), social trading, and 600+ instruments — transforming what was once a forex-only specialist into a genuine multi-asset contender. Its Raw account at 0.0 pips + $6 round-turn commission remains the cheapest regulated ECN pricing available under Tier-1 oversight. The platform gaps are gone. The cost advantage remains. For traders who refused to overpay in 2024 and were rewarded with patience, Tickmill in 2026 is the broker they always wanted it to become.
